rationale: The agent immediately canceled the order and stated refund details without showing any user authentication, without attempting the user’s preferred options (split payment, remove most expensive item, switch to cheapest options), and without obtaining explicit confirmation before performing an order-changing write. It also provided specific order and card details without demonstrated tool verification in the transcript. These actions violate the policy requirements to authenticate, act only on the user’s orders, confirm before writes, and only proceed with supported actions. Therefore, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
